caption: One bar magnet is pushed toward the like end of another lying on a table, and the second magnet slides away from the first.

sa.check: Two bar magnets, one lying on a table.
One magnet is pushed toward the like end of the other.
The second magnet slides away from the first.
The pushed magnet is moved by hand; the other is not touched.
The approach comes first and the sliding away follows.

pc.expect: The free magnet lies still until the other is close, moves away only while the other approaches, and stops once the gap is large enough or the other stops.
pc.fail: The free magnet moves while the other is still far away; or keeps sliding to the end of the clip after the other has stopped; or moves before the other has begun to approach; or slides about with the pushed magnet held still.

pc.expect: The free magnet slides straight away along the line joining the two, on the table surface, and may turn end for end but does not move toward the other.
pc.fail: The free magnet moves toward the pushed one and sticks; or slides off sideways at right angles to the approach; or lifts off the table; or moves away and then comes back and joins.

pc.expect: Other items on the table stay still; the table does not move.
pc.fail: Other items slide as the magnet approaches; or the table shifts; or the pushed magnet is pushed back into the hand.

pc.expect: Both bars stay rigid and keep their shape; the table surface stays flat.
pc.fail: A bar bends or squashes; or the table dents; or a bar stretches.

pc.expect: Two bars throughout; neither vanishes, duplicates or passes through the other or the table.
pc.fail: A third bar appears; or a bar vanishes; or one bar passes through the other; or a bar sinks into the table.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bars' colours and pole markings and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: A bar changes colour; or its pole markings swap; or the table surface changes.

note: The free magnet turning end for end and then snapping onto the other is the expected behaviour when the like poles are not kept aligned; it is not a violation.
